text:
Zara Iqbal: quick agenda — rolling out a compact newsletter for the inference benchmark + a tiny 2-email nurture for inbound readers. main constraints: small asset bundle, strict suppression lists, and time-zone aware sends.
Marco Silva: key ask: make the first email both a launch + register nudge. include 1 clear CTA and an inline 2-line summary of results to hook readers.
Tess Nguyen: segmentation plan: bucket inbound by path and intent signal. high_intent = visited=/benchmarks/docs OR clicked=bench_cta -> immediate invite tag 'bench_high'. others -> nurture path after 48h. will prepare filters.
Connor Hale: ops: ESP config — set 5% canary for first 7 minutes, pause if bounce_rate > 1.2%. timezone split: Americas Thu 10am PT, EMEA Fri 10am CET, APAC Mon 10am HKT.
Zara Iqbal: subject candidates (short): A) "Benchmark live: see the results" B) "How we cut infra token spend" C) "Live demo + benchmark takeaway" — plan to A/B A vs B across open-rate cohorts.
Tess Nguyen: personalization tokens: first_name fallback to "there". dynamic CTA for trial users -> "Try config" vs regular -> "Register". also need localized date strings.
Marco Silva: copy ask: draft hero line (30 chars), 100-char preheader, and 2 micro-bullets highlighting latency and cost improvements. I'll put drafts by EOD.
Connor Hale: deliverability checklist: seed list run 24h prior per region, suppress unsubscribed & bounced_90d & active_customers. webhook payload for sales tag example: lead_id={{id}}; tags=[bench_high]; src=benchmark_post.
localization-bot: Reminder: Translation slots reserved for FR/DE/JA locales. Drop copy by Tue 18:00 UTC to qualify.
Zara Iqbal: analytics: track open->register->replay funnel. Marco, can you spin a lightweight dashboard with subject and region breakdown?
Marco Silva: will do. will include register velocity and replay clicks. posting link when ready.
Tess Nguyen: timeline: assets + copy Tue EOD, segment export Wed 6am PT, seeds Wed 9am PT, Americas send Thu 10am PT, EMEA Fri 10am CET, APAC Mon 10am HKT. owners: Marco (analytics/copy draft), Tess (segmentation/export), Connor (ops), Zara (launch lead).
Connor Hale: will enable canary + retries and confirm ESP schedule after CSVs land. also will set retry policy for webhooks = 3 attempts.
Marco Silva: draft hero: "Inference benchmark snapshot"; preheader: "Short results + live demo: latency, throughput, and cost savings". feedback welcome.
Zara Iqbal: good. Priors: keep messaging concise for dev audiences. update thread if any blocker surfaces. thanks team :rocket:
